caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected at full canvas size; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A large editorial headline names a rise-and-fall pattern, with the central phrase isolated in a lavender rough-lettered capsule.
visual_anatomy.layout: Five tall side-by-side phase columns occupy the upper field; a continuous large wave and a small route marker traverse the lower field, connecting phase-level detail with a single emotional journey.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Headline → left-to-right phase headers and their duration labels → behavioural bullets → lower wave, marker, and embedded internal monologue.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large light sans mixed with a rough display tag, bold phase/subphase labels, compact bullets, and handwritten-style lower annotations.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender, pink, aqua, blue, and muted coral distinguish the five phase columns; the lower wave blends several of those colours as it moves across the sequence.
visual_anatomy.surface: White field, dark outlines, vertical cards with restrained shadows, soft gradient colour in the lower route, and a large rounded curve instead of a conventional axis chart.
visual_anatomy.modules: Five repeated phase cards with duration, a short state label, and behaviour bullets; one continuous lower journey with callouts and a movable marker.
visual_anatomy.density: High but sequenced: repeated columns make the phase detail skimmable while the lower route supplies a single narrative thread.

motion.observed_state_change: The five phase cards stay in place while the large coloured wave/area and its dark marker advance through the lower journey; the sampled midpoint gives the route a visibly different position and emphasis from the opening state.
motion.motion_job: Show traversal through a phase journey rather than add a decorative overlay to an otherwise static list.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Recognise a staged journey and locate a current state without reducing the story to a disconnected list of phases.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Phase journey with a continuous state route.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Synchronise discrete phase cards with one continuous path and position marker so categorical stages and lived progression belong to the same reading model.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the phases are defensible as a real or explicitly heuristic journey; do not imply inevitability or attach durations without support.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source’s creator-life-cycle premise, phase names, duration ranges, curve shape, internal-monologue labels, colour sequence, title cadence, or animation loop.

claim_boundary.note: The visual presents a behavioural phase model and time ranges. The supplied corpus does not independently verify either the model, its durations, or the caption association.
